title: Applied-Energistics-2 issue #9019: Crystal Assembler output config has return text say Circuit Slicer

text:
[issue by BenLeclerc]
### Describe the bug

Configuring the output for the Crystal Assembler, set the output to auto-export.  Then clicking on the Open Output Config lets you select the side to output to.  But the return button on this screen says to return to the "Circuit Slicer", not the "Crystal Assembler" as expected.

### How to reproduce the bug

Configuring the output for the Crystal Assembler, set the output to auto-export.  Then clicking on the Open Output Config lets you select the side to output to.  But the return button on this screen says to return to the "Circuit Slicer", not the "Crystal Assembler" as expected.

This is in the 0.6.1 of ATM 10 Aero pack.

### Expected behavior

The return button should say "Crystal Assembler"

### Additional details

_No response_

### Which minecraft version are you using?

1.21

### On which mod loaders does it happen?

NeoForge

### Crash log

No crash

[comment by shartte (member)]
There is no such thing as a "Crystal Assembler" in this mod. You must be using something from an addon.

[comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)]
Try https://github.com/GlodBlock/ExtendedAE
